title: Let It Be Simple: One-Step Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.05737v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: One-step generation from standard diffusion or Flow-Matching training is rarely effective for text-to-image or video generation without distillation or specialized one-step objectives. We find that VLA action generation behaves strikingly differently. Biasing only the training timestep distribution toward the noise endpoint yields strong one-step policies across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and real-world robot tasks. Moreover, for open-source VLA models with different architectures, simply replacing iterative decoding with a single forward pass often performs comparably to the original multi-step decoding on benchmarks such as LIBERO, CALVIN, and SimplerEnv. We attribute this difference to the condition-target structure of VLA generation, which is closer to image-to-text than text-to-image: rich observations strongly constrain a comparatively compact target. We formalize this intuition through the irreducible velocity loss

translated_title: 让它保持简单：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的单步动作生成
translated_abstract: 对于文生图或视频生成任务，从标准的扩散或流匹配训练直接实现单步生成，在不借助蒸馏或专门单步目标的情况下通常难以奏效。我们发现VLA动作生成却表现出截然不同的特性：仅将训练时间步分布向噪声端点偏置，就能在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro以及真实世界机器人任务上获得强大的单步策略。此外，对于不同架构的开源VLA模型，仅仅将迭代解码替换为单次前向传播，在LIBERO、CALVIN和SimplerEnv等基准上往往就能达到与原始多步解码相当的性能。我们将这一差异归因于VLA生成的条件-目标结构：它更接近于图生文而非文生图——丰富的观测对相对紧凑的目标形成了强约束。我们通过不可约简的速度损失将这一直觉形式化
tldr: 该论文发现VLA动作生成与文生图截然不同——只需将训练时间步分布偏向噪声端点，或直接将多步迭代解码替换为单次前向传播，即可获得性能相当的单步策略，其根本原因在于VLA生成的条件-目标结构更接近图生文任务。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that VLA action generation behaves fundamentally differently from text-to-image generation—strong one-step policies can be achieved simply by biasing training timesteps toward the noise endpoint or replacing iterative decoding with a single forward pass, because VLA's condition-target structure resembles image-to-text rather than text-to-image tasks.
